name: rosetta-word-wheel
code:
use default

let wheel = "ndeokgelw"
let centre = 'k'

available(letters: string) -> MAP[char, int] is
    let counts = MAP[char, int]()

    for letter in letters do
        if !counts.contains_key(letter) then
            counts[letter] = 0
        fi

        counts[letter] = counts[letter] + 1
    od

    return counts
si

spellable(word: string) -> bool is
    let left = available(wheel)

    for letter in word do
        if !left.contains_key(letter) \/ left[letter] == 0 then
            return false
        fi

        left[letter] = left[letter] - 1
    od

    return true
si

let found =
    IO.File.read_all_lines("unixdict.txt")
    |> filter(word =>
        word.length >= 3 /\ word.contains(centre) /\ spellable(word))
    |> collect_list()

write_line(found |> join("\n"))
write_line("")
write_line("{found.count} words")
